the posterior distribution of the fixed effects in a linear mixed effects model is multivariate normal and that the posterior distribution for the variance components can be obtained by a simple modification of the usual REML estimator.
the exact posterior distributions for the fixed effect, random effects and variance parameters in the mixed linear model can be obtained without any numerical integration.

a) the exact posterior distribution for a mixed linear model with known variance of the errors is obtained by using a transformation of variables, b) the exact posterior mean of the variance of random effects can be computed by solving a system of equations, and c) the exact posterior variance of the variance of the random effects is computed by using a transformation.

the mixed model is a natural extension of the classical regression analysis and the Bayesian analysis of the model is a natural generalization of the classical analysis.

the Bayesian analysis of the random effects model is not only feasible, but also computationally efficient.
